title: Move the project to pnpm with the hoisted linker
notes:
Move the project from npm to pnpm, so worktrees share one copy of node_modules through pnpm's global store (hard links) instead of each holding about 1 GB of its own, and installs in a fresh worktree take seconds.

Decided with the user (2026-11-03):
- node-linker=hoisted in .npmrc. Electron Forge packages from node_modules and its docs say pnpm projects need the hoisted layout; the strict isolated layout is given up on purpose. The store (~/.pnpm-global/v3, same filesystem as the repo) still hard-links every file, which is the point.
- Pin pnpm with packageManager in package.json (the user has 9.15.4; pick the version deliberately and say why). If the pinned version blocks dependency install scripts, list exactly what must build (electron, node-pty, esbuild and whatever else needs it) in onlyBuiltDependencies.
- package-lock.json goes; pnpm-lock.yaml comes, generated by pnpm import from the current lockfile so versions do not move. Exact pins in package.json stay as they are (docs record the holds).

Change everywhere npm is named: CLAUDE.md's checks (pnpm test, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit, pnpm exec eslint .), scripts/rebuild.sh, the CI workflow (both the Ubuntu and the Windows job: pnpm/action-setup, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, the cache), docs/, the README, worker-facing text the app itself prints or ships (the create-task skill, pane prompts), and the premake hook. 39 files mention npm or npx today; check each, do not rename blindly (npx inside a user's own project prompt may be about that project).

Done means:
- pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm test, tsc, eslint pass locally and in both CI jobs.
- A full package and make run (the rebuild script's path, into out/, never into ~/.local/opt/dashboard) produces an app whose asar.unpacked holds node-pty's pty.node, usage-worker.js and pane-host-entry.js, and that app starts in a demo instance with its own user data (never the user's running app): a terminal pane opens and echoes.
- A second worktree's pnpm install shows hard links into the store (same inode as the store copy, or du of two worktrees about one copy), with the numbers in the PR.
- docs/workflow decision entry: why pnpm, why hoisted, what it costs. No version bump (workflow-rule-3).

comments.body: Shipped in #201: pnpm@10.33.3, nodeLinker hoisted, settings in pnpm-workspace.yaml, lock from pnpm import, CI on pnpm for both jobs. Two worktrees' packages: 1.4 GB -> 702 MB; a second install takes 1 s.
